description: InterWeave's GZCoord integration: the project's roles (p2p-network-dev for the code, architect-cto for its decision records, devex-tooling for CI) are on the fleet's coordination channel — the same relay and channel as every other project of the fleet, hosted on the coordinator's workspace. Read by gzcoord-inbox when the working copy resolves to project interweave; CLAUDE_BRIDGE_URL and GZCOORD_CHANNEL in the environment override it. No token_env_file: the account's token arrives with fabric-secrets sync. relay_runtime_dir is relative to the workspace, never inside a repository. Written 2026-09-17 when InterWeave became a managed project.
